supersedes.reason: Forensic pre-qualification audit found material obligations not exercised by the 48-case denominator: historical as-of filtering, owner-valid claim provenance/versioning, inferred-claim model/uncertainty requirements, complete bounded declared-context coverage, and learner confirmation boundary. The 48-case contract remains historical evidence and is not accepted as sufficient S02 closure.

cases.obligation: S02 descends from exact frozen S01 closure 4e594a281d437ffa5632c90b9b660379e0147241.
The active 124/116/31 constitution remains unchanged by S02 runtime code.
LRN-151, LRN-152 and LRN-153 remain Learning-owned and no earlier owner is replaced.
I111 remains a read-only query and I112 remains the sole new public SRL mutation command.
LRN-E027 remains a derived projection and LRN-E028 remains an append-oriented observation.
Frozen 001D through 001L artifacts remain byte-identical.
I112 accepts only bounded SRL observation kinds PLAN, MONITOR, EVALUATE, STRATEGY_USE, HELP_REQUEST and BOUNDED_DECLARED_CONTEXT.
I112 requires a stable operation identity.
Same operation identity plus same semantic payload replays the same committed result without a duplicate observation.
Same operation identity plus different semantic payload fails deterministically.
Each new SRL observation is immutable historical state after commit.
A correction creates a successor observation and preserves the corrected observation unchanged.
A correction must reference an existing observation for the same learner.
Observation history is returned in deterministic append order.
SRL persistence survives repository restart.
I112 does not mutate mastery, retention, transfer, assessment, Curriculum or identity truth.
Automated inferred emotion is rejected as canonical SRL context.
Mental-health diagnosis or risk classification is rejected as canonical SRL context.
Personality typing is rejected as canonical SRL context.
Protected or sensitive attribute profiling is rejected as default SRL context.
Unrelated device, browsing, camera, voice or physiological telemetry is rejected as canonical learner truth.
Missing bounded declared context is represented as unknown or absent and never as a negative trait.
I111 produces a versioned/as-of LearnerModelProjection without writing source truth.
Every projected claim carries an explicit standing from OBSERVED, DERIVED, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, STALE, CONTRADICTED or NOT_APPLICABLE.
No evidence produces UNKNOWN rather than zero competence.
Self-confidence or SRL self-report is never converted into competence or mastery.
AI-assisted success is not represented as independent capability unless owner-valid evidence supports independence under the applicable conditions.
Materially contradictory owner-valid source claims remain visible as CONTRADICTED rather than being silently averaged.
Stale owner-valid source state remains distinguishable from current state.
Projected meaningful claims preserve exact source references and source versions sufficient for provenance.
Identical exact source inputs, SRL history and policy version produce semantically identical projection output.
Source input ordering cannot change semantic projection output.
LearnerModelProjection may summarize SRL observations without rewriting their history.
LearnerModelProjection remains bounded to learning-purpose claims and does not become a general psychological dossier.
Calling I111 does not add an SRL observation.
Calling I111 does not add a mastery projection, assessment attempt, learner-model object or identity record.
Repeated I111 queries over unchanged inputs return the same semantic projection.
I111 can operate when no SRL history exists and returns explicit unknown state rather than failing or fabricating.
Malformed observation kind fails without partial persistence.
Forbidden context fails without recording an idempotency success receipt.
Correction of another learner's observation fails without mutation.
Repository restart reconstructs committed SRL history from durable state rather than process memory.
The exact S01 36-case qualification continues to pass on S02 head.
The full existing learning/lab regression suite passes on the S02 head.
Existing mastery rule observation/completion/confidence does not directly establish mastery remains intact.
Existing Learning runtime persistence/idempotency behavior remains intact.
S02 introduces no authority for competency equivalence or external asynchronous score commit ingress.
S02 may be frozen only after isolated S02 tests and all required cumulative checks pass on the exact changed head.
An I111 projection at time T excludes SRL observations recorded after T.
A correction recorded after projection time T does not retroactively hide the predecessor observation that was active at T.
A meaningful projected claim without exact source references is rejected rather than admitted as learner truth.
A meaningful projected claim from an unrecognized or external semantic owner is rejected; external standards cannot become Learner Model authority.
Every meaningful source reference has an exact source version, and future-dated source claims are excluded from earlier as-of projections.
An INFERRED projected claim requires exact model/algorithm version and explicit uncertainty; inference cannot masquerade as observation.
Projected claims preserve materially applicable interpretation metadata including policy version, evidence cutoff/coverage, freshness, assistance condition and limitations.

The bounded declared-context family includes help preference, readiness for independent attempt and strategy preference, and only learner-declared or learner-confirmed context may be labeled canonical declared context.
